# telnyx_enterprise_reputation_number_ownership_confirm (Action)

Confirms that the enterprise still owns a flagged phone number, or gives it up.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enterprise_id` (String) The enterprise id.
- `phone_number` (String) The phone number id.
- `still_own` (Boolean) `true` confirms you still own the number. `false` reports that you no longer own it and removes it from Number Reputation.

### Optional

- `evidence_document_id` (String) Optional id of an uploaded document supporting the confirmation.
